snippet.title: Kindergarten 3 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Kindergarten 3 is now available on Steam! With 9 all new story assignments to complete, 50 Monstermon to collect, and tons of graphic ways to die, Kindergarten 3 is the best day of school yet!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2695570/Kindergarten_3/
